products.title: WFH Shirt -- Lichen Green Heather
products.description: Description: The term WFH is known far and wide these days, but this shirt wasn't just made to be kept cooped up inside - on the contrary! This shirt was made to make you feel comfortable regardless of almost anything else. The lightweight brushed fabric is knit, so it manages sweat and heat with ease but it also provides a ton of flexibility for whatever comes next. Pair that with the perfect classic fit and rounded hem so it can be tucked or untucked, this shirt is going to be an instant customer favorite.
